description: Attribution-ranked gate-correction channel shutdown repeated per training seed of physical20_environment_gate; inference only, no training. Same 64 fixed validation IDs, IG32 over mask 0->1, methods, k values, random rankings (RNG 20261013) and chemical-system bootstrap (3000 resamples, seed 20261015) as explanation_controls.

estimands.mean_abs_response_eV: mean over 64 materials of |full - masked| prediction (eV); random averaged over 20 rankings per material
estimands.ci95: material-weighted chemical-system cluster bootstrap percentile interval
estimands.ig_over_random_ratio: point ratio of the two mean absolute responses
estimands.ig_minus_random_ci95_eV: paired (by material, same system draws) bootstrap interval of IG minus random mean absolute response
